## Flagship Systems & Architectures
- [Cloud Backend Optimization & Migration](https://github.com/Anandhu362/Cloud-Cost-Optimization): Refactored Node.js backend services from always-on virtual machines to Google Cloud Run serverless containers, slashing monthly overhead by >90% while achieving sub-second autoscaling.
- [CloudDrive App Platform](https://github.com/Anandhu362/Clouddrive-App-Projects-Detailes): Secure cloud-native file management platform built with isolated Google Cloud Storage buckets, user quotas, encrypted link sharing, and zero-duplication file hashing.
- [Ferrari Foods Cash Vault Ledger](https://github.com/Anandhu362/ferrarimanagement2): Production fintech ledger coordinating cash collections, branch deliveries, and payment settlements (>AED 1,000,000+) across Sharjah and Abu Dhabi with Baileys automated WhatsApp notifications.
- [Business Web Platforms (Botila)](https://botilademo.vercel.app/): Fast, accessible corporate web platforms developed for food trading, manufacturing, and commercial enterprises in Dubai.
- [Up4TexAll (Re4Circular) Platform](https://github.com/Anandhu362/up4texall-Projects-Detailes): Circular textile recycling and marketplace portal featuring multimodal upcycle design ideas using Google Gemini AI.
- [Custom Cloud WireGuard VPN](https://github.com/Anandhu362/Virtual-Private-Server-): Hardened private Virtual Private Server deployed on GCP Compute Engine with strict firewall rules and kernel-level WireGuard encryption.
